//: The THIRD typecheck program: the native-leaf TESTS. They need both sides
of the platform split at once — the native suffix list (so './button'
resolves to button.native.tsx, exactly as the vitest `native` project and
Metro do) AND the DOM lib (the tests assert on the DOM react-native-web
emits under jsdom). Neither existing program can take them:
tsconfig.json resolves the .web leaves, and tsconfig.native.json
deliberately has no DOM lib so the SHIPPED native leaves keep
typechecking against React Native's own types alone. skipLibCheck (from
the base) is what lets react-native's ambient types coexist with lib.dom
here — the same coexistence expo/tsconfig.base relies on in the app.
